name: udb-desktop-bridge
description: Connect ChatGPT to the UDB Windows desktop through its existing Cloudflare Access-protected MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to the UDB staging desktop through a device-scoped MCP endpoint protected by Cloudflare Access. The user must complete OAuth consent. Available tools and permissions are determined by the connected UDB server and Windows owner policy.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my UDB connection status and show the desktop tools available to this session.
